topic: The three-way fight for your thumb — TikTok 81, YouTube 80, Instagram 55 minutes a day (US, 2025)

drafts.text: You said one more video. Three apps heard a challenge. US, 2025: TikTok bags 81 minutes of your day. YouTube 80. Instagram 55. Nobody won on purpose. Retention Loop is coming to the menu — it counts the seconds you don't. https://data-snack.com #retentionloop #autoplay
